title: Cron Scheduler
description: Time-based triggers create runtime tasks for scheduled work

steps.content: Set up a daily health check that runs the test suite every morning at 6am

steps.annotation: Cron scheduler stores the rule; it doesn't own the execution

steps.content:
Schedule created: daily-health-check
  Cron: 0 6 * * * (daily at 6:00 AM)
  Next trigger: 2026-04-10 06:00:00
steps.annotation: Schedule record persisted separately from runtime task records

steps.content:
[Cron Tick] 06:00:00
  Evaluating rules...
  Match: daily-health-check (0 6 * * *)
  Creating runtime task...
steps.annotation: Cron tick evaluates rules -- time triggering is decoupled from execution

steps.content:
[RuntimeTask] Created record rt_cron_001
  Source: cron:daily-health-check
  Command: npm test -- --ci
  Status: queued
steps.annotation: Trigger creates the same kind of runtime task as user-initiated background work

steps.content:
[Notification] Runtime task rt_cron_001 completed
  Preview: All 52 tests passed
  Output: .runtime/rt_cron_001/output.txt
steps.annotation: Execution follows the same runtime pipeline as any other background task

steps.content: Daily health check is set up. It will run npm test every morning at 6am, creating a runtime task each time. Results come through the same notification mechanism.
steps.annotation: Scheduling and execution are decoupled: cron triggers, runtime executes, notifications report
